headline: Uzbekistan provides Uzbek language corpus to OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and other companies to train AI
summary: Uzbekistan has built a 20 billion-token Uzbek language dataset and offered it free to AI developers including OpenAI and Anthropic. The stated aim is to improve AI understanding and generation of Uzbek.
why: Training data for large language models is a key input for AI developers, and national language datasets shape how well these models serve local markets.
original_headline: O‘zbekiston OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta va boshqa kompaniyalarga SIni o‘qitish uchun o‘zbek tili korpusini taqdim etdi
